definitions.full: H3870. Luz II. לוּז proper name, of a location 1. former name of Bethel Gen 28:19 (J), 35:6 (E), 48:3 (P), Josh 18:13 (twice in verse) (P), Judg 1:23 ; apparently distinct from Biblical לוּ֫זָה מִבֵּיתאֵֿל Josh 16:2 (J E; but ׳ל here perhaps explanatory gloss, see Di); ᵐ5 Λουζα , Gen 28:19 [Ουλαμ]μαυς 2 city in hands of Hittites Judg 1:26 (on conjectures as to site see GFM); ᵐ5 Λουζα . לוח (√ of following, meaning unknown; compare perhaps Arabic shine, gleam, flash (of star, lightning, etc.), or Syriac wipe out, efface with reference to smooth surface; but this = לחה ).
